messages:
alex: Kicked off a matrixfold attention sweep across H100 / A100 / L40S. Quick notes: fusion variant looks promising on L40S but we're seeing a spike in KV-cache spills on H100 at seq=2048. Uploading traces now.
perf-bot: artifact uploaded -> gs://redwood-perf/artifacts/1869990123/matrixfold-sweep.tar.gz :floppy_disk:
sasha: Can you paste the raw perf counters / allocator logs? curious where the memory pressure originates.
alex: ```
# perf counters (excerpt)
device: H100
seq=1024,batch=4,variant=fusion -> kernel=matfold_fused, gpu_mem_used=18.4GB, kv_spill=0
seq=2048,batch=2,variant=fusion -> kernel=fallback_paged, gpu_mem_used=28.9GB, kv_spill=1 (spilled 1.2GB to host)
kernel_selection: fusion:124, flash:98, paged:76
```
maria: Hmm that kv_spill at 2048 is alarming on H100. On L40S fusion wins for batch >=8 and seq upto 2048 in our earlier runs. Could be tiling heuristic or allocator interaction.
chen: I repro'd a different regression after the kernel-priority reorder change last week. Repro steps are short: run the microbench with --trace=kvcache and watch for page_fault_count bump.
alex: Repro command I'm using locally: ```
./scripts/bench_attn --device h100 --seqs 128,512,1024,2048 --batches 1,2,4,8 --variants fusion,flash,paged --trace kv,alloc --out /tmp/matrixfold-186999.json
```
sasha: Uploaded flamegraph (wall-time) -> http://perf.redwood/internal/1869990123/flame.html. Looks like matfold_fused does extra memcpy before kernel launch on H100 for small batches. Might trigger allocator fragmentation.
maria: Short-term mitigation: prefer flash for batch <=4 on H100 when seq <=1024. That avoids the mem-copy path and keeps latency stable. Longer term: we should tighten kvcache eviction threshold and avoid host spill for borderline cases.
chen: Agreed. I can add a quick heuristic guard in kernel-policy: if device==H100 and batch<=4 and seq<=1024 -> prefer flash. Test first in canary.
infra-bot: Canary rule created: attn-kernel-policy-v2 -> rolling to h100-pool in 10m. Notifying oncall channel. :rocket:
alex: I'll run the full seq sweep on L40S tonight and add numbers to the kernel-heatmap. Also flagging a perf regression ticket (TICKET-4592) with attached traces. TL;DR: fusion still valuable for throughput on L40S, but H100 needs a small policy tweak to avoid KV spills at high seqs / small batches.
